decisions.reason: The valve and flow clauses from this message are already represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY; the new bowl-to-electronics leak constraint is independently owned by the source Requirement.
The cleaning clause from this message is already represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY, while bowl leak prevention does not change the sanitary fluid-path state.
The leak-prevention decision does not change the established bottom spout location, barista orientation, or spout geometry.
Requiring the bowl not to leak into electronics does not determine or modify bowl capacity or the existing deep-well form.
Liquid containment at the bowl-electronics boundary is distinct from controlling splashing during mixing and leaves the splash target unchanged.
The leak-prevention requirement has no necessary effect on the machine's green accent color.
The bowl sealing and electronics-protection decision does not change the display name or machine wording.
The containment constraint does not alter the established DJ-turntable-inspired visual identity.
The source adds a product containment constraint but does not change the requested system-layout deliverable or its selected design direction.
The source specifies required leak-prevention behavior but does not select, replace, or remove any component or BOM deliverable.
The added containment constraint does not alter the V1 speed priority or policy of using simple off-the-shelf components where practical.
Protecting electronics from bowl leakage does not itself change the requirement to provide a basic wiring plan or establish any wiring-plan detail.
